_comment: Spine CONNECTED evidence (PR #88, DEC-062). Every claim names a test file and the exact test title inside it; scripts/verify-spine-evidence.mjs fails when the file or the title is not there. A claim is evidence that a behaviour is exercised, not a claim that the format, the customer or the governance is verified — those stay with the owner questions (O1-O9).

policy.route: A routed screen may be graded CONNECTED only when its journey, empty, error and loading states are each evidenced, and the shell supplies the stale/offline state.
policy.capability: A named capability may be graded CONNECTED when at least one test exercises it end-to-end (not a unit of a helper it happens to import).
policy.loadingNotApplicable: Allowed only for a page with no page-level loading branch; the page source is checked for `isLoading` and `<Skeleton` before the excuse is accepted.
policy.governed: Not claimed here. GOVERNED needs authorization, audit and entity-scope evidence and is PR #89.

stale.title: reads stale as stale, not as current, and says what to do about it
stale.proves: The shell distinguishes stale data from current data in text, not colour, and states the recovery action.

data.csv-xlsx-intake.title: fails closed on unclosed quotes, malformed quotes, extra columns, and invalid UTF-8 bytes
data.csv-xlsx-intake.proves: Malformed intake is rejected whole rather than half-imported.

data.mapping.title: accepts the documented D365 column set (regression: it was rejected before 2026-10-21)
data.mapping.proves: The documented D365 F&O header set maps into the staging pipeline. The shape itself remains unverified (O1).

data.validation.title: quarantines D365 rows with reasons and never promotes a blocked batch
data.validation.proves: Invalid rows are quarantined with reasons and the batch cannot be promoted around them.

data.quarantine.title: blocks a balanced remainder when any chunk has quarantined rows, retaining raw typed reasons
data.quarantine.proves: A balanced remainder is not promoted while any chunk is quarantined, and the typed reason survives.

data.control-totals.title: promotes to the ledger and ties out to exact control totals
data.control-totals.proves: Promotion ties out to exact-decimal control totals.

data.lineage.title: maps a well-formed row into a GL entry with canonical period and provenance row
data.lineage.proves: Every accepted row carries its provenance and canonical period.

close.period-entity-scope.title: unknown entity and legacy entity display labels cannot evade a lock
close.period-entity-scope.proves: Entity scope comes from the period authority, not from a label that can be forged.

close.write-guards.title: enforces the period-close write guard on a D365 batch
close.write-guards.proves: A closed period refuses the batch before any financial state changes.

close.state-machine.title: hard-close → reopen is valid
close.state-machine.proves: Period transitions obey a closed state machine rather than ad-hoc flags.

close.trial-balance.title: renders the trial balance the real store derives from an imported journal
close.trial-balance.proves: The trial balance on screen is derived from the imported ledger, not a fixture.

close.tie-out.title: quarantines messy imports atomically, enforces period-close write guard, promotes exact-decimal USD/EUR batches, consolidates with ASC 830 CTA & ASC 810 IC, and ties out XLSX/PPTX outputs
close.tie-out.proves: The close journey runs end-to-end over two entities and two currencies and ties out its outputs.

close.audit-chain.title: first entry chains to the genesis hash and carries a 256-bit digest
close.audit-chain.proves: The audit trail is a hash chain from genesis, not an append-only list with no integrity.

close.corrections.title: creates a correction from an accepted finding and tracks it
close.corrections.proves: A correction is created from a finding and tracked through its lifecycle.

analyze.exception-rules.title: planted unbalanced journal appears as a candidate with coverage stated
analyze.exception-rules.proves: A catalogue rule finds a planted problem and the run states what it examined.

analyze.findings-disposition.title: REQUESTED → APPLIED → REVERIFIED is the legal path, each step audited
analyze.findings-disposition.proves: A finding disposition follows one audited path; no shortcut sets it.

report.board-pack.title: exports the same figures the screen shows, derived from the ledger
report.board-pack.proves: The exported pack carries the same figures the screen shows.

report.tie-back.title: follows the ledger, not a hardcoded figure
report.tie-back.proves: A changed ledger changes the pack, so the tie-back cannot be a stored constant.
